name: Irregulier
description: Fêlure du réel générant des fissures dans les défenses statiques ennemies rendant leurs positions vulnérables.

subject.archetype: Glitched Shadow Warrior - Irregulier Combat Specialist

loadout.armor_outfit: Tattered military armor fused with living shadow matter, plates twisted and warped by spatial distortion, metal flowing like melted wax under gravitational anomalies, exposed sections revealing corrupted flesh merging with dark energy tendrils, fragments of reality phasing in and out of the armor's surface, pieces floating in anti-gravitational bubbles around the body
loadout.arsenal: Obsidian-violet crystalline blade - impossibly thin mono-molecular edge that glitches between solid and ethereal states, the weapon cracks the air around it revealing parallel dimensional slices, energy ripples emanate from the blade creating reality fractures, accompanied by floating geometric shards of corrupted metal orbiting the wielder

attitude.behavior: Dynamic combat stance with body angled against broken gravity - one foot planted on cracked ground while the other leg floats at impossible angle due to localized gravity malfunction, weapon thrust forward leaving purple energy trails that split into parallel reality echoes, shadow tendrils erupting from back and limbs actively tearing at the dimensional fabric, mid-stride lunge into enemies while reality fragments around each movement
attitude.emotion: Mad ecstasy of dimensional fusion - eyes rolled back showing only whites, mouth contorted in silent scream of cosmic awareness, veins pulsing with violet-black energy visible through scarified skin, expression fluctuating between transcendent bliss and horrified realization of multiple overlapping realities

scenography.setting: Reality collapse epicenter - multi-layered dimensional battlefield: intact and destroyed building states overlapping in same space creating 2D architectural impossible geometry, ground fractured into parallel battlefield layers visible through cracks showing simultaneous combat scenarios, floating debris masses defying gravity in conflicting directions, fractured sky with impossible celestial combinations
